files.content:
# Pixel Snakes & Ladders

A single-player, offline Snakes and Ladders game made with HTML, CSS, and plain JavaScript. No packages, server, or network access are needed.

## Run

Open `index.html` in a modern browser. Use **Roll** to roll the die and **Start over** to reset. Both controls work with the keyboard; focus is visible. The board and changing game status have accessible labels.

## Rules and board

The token starts on square 1. Each roll moves 1–6 squares. An exact roll is required to reach 30; an overshoot leaves the token in place. Landing on a ladder climbs up, and landing on a snake slides down.

- Ladders: 3 → 11, 8 → 17, 20 → 27
- Snakes: 14 → 5, 24 → 16, 29 → 9
- Win: land exactly on square 30

## Build evidence

The complete app is the four source files in this folder: `index.html`, `styles.css`, `game.js`, and this README. All graphics are drawn with text and CSS, all paths are relative, and the app makes no external requests. The responsive layout includes a narrow-screen single-column mode and supports viewports down to 360px.
